name: fit-map-viewer
description: Visualize GPS tracks from FIT files on an interactive map

scripts.start: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:client && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json src/index.ts
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput & tsx watch --include 'public/**' --tsconfig tsconfig.json src/index.ts
